reviewer: independent package_verification agent; not the experiment author
decision: No remaining executable-contract blocker for the one declared bounded standalone postpass diagnostic. Root owns execution authorization and sequencing.
unchanged_from_initial_executable_plan: five complete source arrays and original token/window mapping
Small checkpoint and all native package identities

one model initialization and one attempt per fixed input

resolved_findings.finding: Requested int8 was incorrectly required to resolve to literal int8.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only effective CPU int8 or int8_float32 is accepted; actual type is recorded, and float32/float16/CUDA controls reject.

resolved_findings.finding: Sampled checks and worker exit alone could miss a recorded cap violation or incomplete result.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final controller assessor checks recorded process and per-input high-water, startup/input/total elapsed times, completed original case order, unchanged text/order flags, model lifecycle, exact 23 encode and 23 align calls with zero generation/detection, and exited/empty owned process group.

resolved_findings.finding: A blocked native invocation could lose the current attempted-call record.
resolved_findings.resolution: Each encode/align attempt and exact arguments are checkpointed before invocation; completed encoder data and returned raw path/probabilities are checkpointed before path validation.

reviewed_meaningful_new_cases: CPU effective type and wrong backend
attempt evidence before interrupted native calls

limits_of_clearance: This is a source/protocol review; no timing accuracy or semantic acceptance is inferred.
The postpass preserves baseline text errors and uses upstream duration heuristics; optional invalid word evidence falls back rather than fabricating timings.
Four short-clip token arrays are re-encoded retained text, not recovered original decoder token sequences.
Owned-process RSS and standalone export checks do not measure full-application/browser headroom.
Actual outputs still require all fixed timing gates and the complete independent reference review before any production decision.
